system.name: Poisson Variational Autoencoder (P-VAE)
system.one_liner: A VAE whose latents are Poisson spike counts, combining perception as inference, rate coding and predictive coding; its linear version is amortized sparse coding.

content.variant_note: three colour-coded citation boxes fan into a circled plus and a rainbow-outlined banner with three claim bullets below; the right half compares two grids of learned filters
content.argues: The Poisson VAE brings perception-as-inference, rate coding and predictive coding under Bayesian inference, and its linear version learns sparse-coding-like Gabor filters where a Gaussian VAE learns PCA-like ones.
content.subject: three neuroscience theories merging into the Poisson VAE, three claims, and learned filters of linear Poisson versus linear Gaussian VAE

A metabolic cost term emerges in the model objective "for free," suggesting a connection to Sparse Coding.

summary: The Poisson VAE encodes inputs into discrete spike counts and combines three neuroscience ideas: perception as inference, rate coding and predictive coding. Figure 1 is a graphical abstract in one rounded grey frame split by a dotted line. At left, three colour-coded boxes of author-year citations (red, green, blue) merge through a circled plus into a rainbow-outlined banner reading Poisson Variational Autoencoder, with three bullet claims below. At right, a rounded pill states that amortized sparse coding is a special case, above two equal grids of learned filters: Gabor-like for the linear Poisson VAE, noisy and PCA-like for the linear Gaussian VAE.
summary_zh: 泊松 VAE 把感知即推断、速率编码和预测编码三种理论合在一起。图是一张图形摘要：左侧三个彩色引文框经加号汇入彩虹描边的模型横幅，下列三条要点；右侧并排两组学到的滤波器网格，对比线性泊松 VAE 与高斯 VAE。
notes: Prior kinds kept and contribution-mosaic added for the claim bullets and the graphical-abstract layout. The two halves are not framed or titled, so they are counted as two panels only because a dotted line separates them and the right half has a claim pill as heading; the image grids are one bitmap each.
